name: database
description: Database implementation and safety for relational stores: a /database:review command, a database-engineer worker that applies schema, migration, indexing and pooling work, and a PreToolUse guard that asks for confirmation before a destructive statement (DROP/TRUNCATE/unqualified DELETE-UPDATE) lands. The design and statement rubric itself lives in the sql plugin's sql-best-practices skill; dialect audits in mysql/mariadb/postgresql.
